filters.scope: Source and tier narrow the referral funnel only.

funnel.label: Referral funnel
funnel.heading: Where people drop off
funnel.note: Counts screens the server knows about: invites not yet claimed or expired, plus every journey from a first ticket, plus crisis screens. Screens that stayed on a phone in the app are not counted, and a crisis screen cannot be matched to a ticket.
funnel.journeys: A journey is a first ticket and every reroute after it; it counts at a stage when any of its tickets reached that stage or a later one.

equity.label: Equity
equity.heading: Loop closed, by group
equity.flagBelow: {group} tickets close {points} points below the {overall}% overall rate (black line).
equity.flagAbove: {group} tickets close {points} points above the {overall}% overall rate (black line).
equity.period: Always the last 90 days, whatever the period filter says, so a group cannot be worked out by comparing periods.
equity.basis: Per ticket: closed means the ticket reached seen or later. Groups come from the buckets people chose to share, language included; a ticket whose person shared none is in "No answer given". A gap of 10 points or more from the overall rate is flagged.

timeliness.label: Timeliness
timeliness.heading: Timeliness by tier
timeliness.basis: Counts tickets that reached seen or went overdue. A ticket still waiting inside its window, or one the person declined or withdrew, is not counted.
timeliness.overdueIds: Ids are pseudonyms made for this dashboard; they are not ticket codes.
timeliness.waitNote: The listed waits of the sample directory. These are mock services, not measurements.

safety.label: Safety
safety.heading: Crisis response and safety
safety.note: Contact is what the person told the app. Adverse events are not part of this build.

admin.heading: Demo controls
admin.intro: For the person running the demo. Everything here is sample data.

clock.heading: Demo clock
clock.failed: The clock could not be read.
clock.off: Demo controls are off on this server. The clock cannot be moved and the data cannot be reset.
clock.offset: Ahead of real time by {days} days
clock.offsetZero: The demo clock is at real time.
clock.moved: Moved the clock. {count} tickets turned overdue.
clock.moveFailed: The clock could not be moved.
clock.scope: Deadlines, the day-7 check, ticket dates and invite expiry follow the demo clock. Staff sign-in and the signed hand-over window stay on real time.

reset.heading: Reset to the seed
reset.warning: This deletes everything, including tickets made on phones, reloads the sample data, puts the clock back to real time and makes a new invite for Noura. A phone that held a ticket registers again the next time it contacts the server and drops that ticket; the check-ins saved on the phone stay.
reset.failed: The reset failed. Nothing may have changed; read the clock again.
reset.off: Reset is off because demo controls are off.

crisis.heading: Crisis numbers
crisis.label: Line
crisis.note: A number shows as not verified until someone has called it. It stays on the crisis screen either way.
